---
title: "About Us"
---

M&M Consulting brings together expertise in psychometrics and quantitative methodology to support better measurement and evidence-based research.

## Our consultants

### Nicolas Mireles, PhD| Psychometrician

Nicolas Mireles, Ph.D., has over seven years of experience in quantitative research, statistical analysis, psychometrics, and higher education assessment. He currently serves as a psychometrician at the National Board for Certified Counselors, specializing in assessment development, validation, and statistical modeling. His consulting experience includes supporting researchers and organizations with research design, advanced quantitative methods, instrument development, and program evaluation. Nicolas is passionate about translating complex data into meaningful insights that inform research, practice, and decision-making. He holds a Ph.D. in Assessment and Measurement from James Madison University.

### Alejandro Martinez, MA, MS| Quantitative Methodologist

Alejandro Martinez is a Ph.D. candidate in Quantitative Psychology at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, where he also earned his master's degree in Quantitative Psychology. He specializes in advanced statistical methods, including structural equation modeling, multilevel modeling, longitudinal data analysis, and survival analysis. His consulting and collaborative research experience spans health sciences, developmental psychology, and behavioral sciences, with projects examining substance use, adolescent development, and bicultural identity. He brings expertise in research design, statistical modeling, and psychometric evaluation to help researchers address complex questions and draw meaningful conclusions from their data.

## How we work

We emphasize rigorous methodology, transparent communication, and solutions tailored to clients' research and assessment needs.
